sets.description: Set to equip, additional objects in within are entities to create and give to the player.

entities.description: List of entities key-value pairs to create onto the player.

items.description: Object representing a entity key-value pairs.

characters.description: Characters equipment config. each objects corresponds to Security, Scientist, Maintenance, HEV, Hazard and Operative respectivelly.

description.description: message used on equipment where %1 is the player name and %2 is the set's description.

sets.description: List of sets names to pick up randomly.

fade.description: RGB used for the fade effect.

notice.description: RGB used for the notice message.

trigger.description: Target after equip, passes the player as !activator.

sets_enforce.description: List of sets names to always equip.

bloodpuddle.title: Blood puddles
bloodpuddle.description: Controls blood puddle behavior and appearance.

persistent.description: If true, puddles remain indefinitely until the map is about at 100 free entity slots. Otherwise they fade out as soon as the monster owner disappears.

default_size.description: Random size range for puddles (min, max).

zombie_uncrab.description: Controls headcrab detachment behavior from zombies.

track_health.description: If true, spawning depends on damage dealt. Otherwise always spawns with full health

deathdrop.title: Death drop
deathdrop.description: Entity classname to spawn. Empty string means no drop chance. 'grenade' is a special name and will spawn a timed grenade.

aiming_lasers.title: Aiming lasers
aiming_lasers.description: Controls laser aiming visuals for monsters.

detonate_time.description: Time, in seconds, at which the flashbang will detonate since it's thrown.

capacity.description: Max sentry spawn capacity per engineer

distance.description: Distance from the engineer to spawn

cooldown_start.description: Time until engineer can place a sentry after spawning

cooldown_combat.description: How often to try to drop a sentry in combat, in seconds

cooldown_idle.description: How often to try to drop a sentry while idle/roaming, in seconds

chance.description: Chance to drop a sentry while idle/roaming, in percentage 0-100

recharge_time.description: Time (In seconds) required to fully recharge. 0 means never recharge

stray.description: when shooting the zombies in the chest or stomach there is a risk of damaging the canister, in percentage 1-100

degrade.description: damaged canisters will degrade until they explode when the zombie dies, this sets how fast this happens

max_leap_z.description: Panther won't pounce at enemies if they're higher up than this from the panther's location

max_leap.description: Panther won't pounce at enemies beyond this range

allow_reload.description: When true the map scripts will keep json schemas in memory and register a command to reload json files run time. useful to test specific changes without restarting the whole map.

skip_validation.description: Set true to skip json schema validation and improve loading time. You MUST define everything from default config in here or exceptions WILL raise. You MUST NOT use wrong variables or exceptions WILL raise.

active.description: When active. tracks player data and writes to scripts/maps/store/bts_rc_datatracker.json

characters.description: Control player characters and their voice profiles.

voice_profiles.description: Named voice profiles referenced by playable characters.

hands.description: View model hands used for the character, See: https://github.com/Mikk155/bts_rc/wiki/characters#player-view-hands

voice.description: Name of a voice_profiles entry used by this character.
